cues.en: Hey, it's Andre here with a quick little tip for you.
cues.zh: 嘿，我是 Andrei，給你一個小提示。

cues.en: Now, over the next couple of videos, Daniel is going to show you his machine learning workflow.
cues.zh: 接下來幾支影片，Daniel 會示範他的機器學習工作流程。

cues.en: And one of the things that he's going to do is, well, clean the data, transform it, and do all sorts of manipulation to it.
cues.zh: 其中一件事，就是清理資料、轉換資料，進行各種操作。

cues.en: Now, I want us to take a high level view right now, because when we're working with Jupyter Notebooks, it can get really confusing.
cues.zh: 現在想先從整體來看，因為操作 Jupyter Notebook 時，可能會很混亂。

cues.en: It almost seems like we're doing a bunch of steps without understanding the why.
cues.zh: 好像只是做了一連串步驟，卻不知道為什麼。

cues.en: But I want to take a step back here and understand why we do the things we're going to do over the next couple of videos you see as a data scientist.
cues.zh: 所以，先退一步，了解接下來幾支影片，為什麼要做那些事。身為資料科學家，

cues.en: More data doesn't necessarily mean it's always good.
cues.zh: 資料多，不代表一定好。

cues.en: I mean, yes, generally the more data we have, the more data we have to work with.
cues.zh: 當然，一般來說，資料越多，就有越多資料可處理。

cues.en: But at the end of the day, we can have completely useless data.
cues.zh: 但到頭來，也可能都是完全沒用的資料。

cues.en: We only want useful data so that we can get real results, real actionable steps that we can take.
cues.zh: 我們只想要有用的資料，才能得到真正的結果，以及實際能採取的行動。

cues.en: And what we're going to see Danielle do is do this step before we even create our machine learning model.
cues.zh: 在建立機器學習模型之前，會先看到 Daniel 做這個步驟。

cues.en: You see, we want to run this step.
cues.zh: 我們要執行這一步。

cues.en: Cleaning data, transforming data and reducing data.
cues.zh: 清理資料、轉換資料，以及縮減資料。

cues.en: So let's talk about that.
cues.zh: 來談談。

cues.en: Why do we need to clean data?
cues.zh: 為什麼要清理資料？

cues.en: Well, we want to remove and replace data.
cues.zh: 因為需要移除與取代資料。

cues.en: Because sometimes data is missing, right?
cues.zh: 有時資料會缺漏，對吧？

cues.en: We might have tables with missing values, missing labels.
cues.zh: 資料表可能有缺失值、缺少標籤。

cues.en: That's not going to help us and it's not going to allow us to build the right machine learning model.
cues.zh: 這沒有幫助，也無法讓我們建立正確的機器學習模型。

cues.en: So we usually remove a row or a column that's empty or has missing fields, or we might calculate some
cues.zh: 所以，通常會移除空白或有缺失欄位的列、欄，或者計算某種

cues.en: sort of average.
cues.zh: 平均值。

cues.en: If we're doing, house prices will fill an empty price list to maybe an average house.
cues.zh: 如果處理房價，可能把缺少的價格，填成一間一般房屋的平均價格。

cues.en: You might even notice some outliers in your data and just remove them.
cues.zh: 也可能發現資料中的離群值，直接移除。

cues.en: Next is data transformation.
cues.zh: 接著是資料轉換。

cues.en: You see, computers don't really understand concepts, right?
cues.zh: 電腦其實不了解概念，對吧？

cues.en: Most of the time, computers just understand ones and zeros.
cues.zh: 大多數時候，電腦只理解 1 與 0。

cues.en: Just numbers, really, in order for us to teach computers.
cues.zh: 實際上就是數字。為了教電腦，

cues.en: Most of the time, we want to transform our data into some sort of form that a computer can understand.
cues.zh: 通常想把資料轉成電腦能理解的形式。

cues.en: So what we're going to see is Daniel actually convert some of our information into numbers.
cues.zh: 所以，會看到 Daniel 把一些資訊，實際轉成數字。

cues.en: You might have things like the price of a house or a salary that are numbers and easy for us to create models with because computers understand numbers fairly easily.
cues.zh: 像房價或薪資，本來就是數字，很容易用來建立模型，因為電腦相當容易理解數字。

cues.en: But it might find it hard to know what a color is.
cues.zh: 但要理解顏色，可能就很難。

cues.en: What is green?
cues.zh: 綠色是什麼？

cues.en: What is blue?
cues.zh: 藍色是什麼？

cues.en: A computer doesn't understand that.
cues.zh: 電腦不理解。

cues.en: Instead, we convert colors into numbers like our gbps colors so that a computer understands.
cues.zh: 所以，改把顏色轉成 RGB 這類數值表示，讓電腦能理解。

cues.en: A good way we transform data is usually between zeros and ones such as Do you have heart disease or do you not know?
cues.zh: 常見的轉換方式，就是使用 0 與 1，例如是否罹患心臟病。

cues.en: Heart disease is zero.
cues.zh: 沒有心臟病，設為 0。

cues.en: Heart disease is one.
cues.zh: 有心臟病，設為 1。

cues.en: We have to make sure that data across the board uses the same units.
cues.zh: 還必須確保整份資料，採用相同單位。

cues.en: Maybe one data uses meters, another data uses yards.
cues.zh: 也許某些資料用公尺，另一些用碼。

cues.en: This idea of transforming data into a useful form is really, really difficult and it just comes with practice.
cues.zh: 把資料轉換成有用形式，其實非常困難，只能靠練習。

cues.en: But you're going to see Daniel how he transforms data so it's more and more workable.
cues.zh: 不過，會看到 Daniel 如何轉換資料，讓它越來越容易使用。

cues.en: So once we've cleaned the data, once we've transformed the data, next is to reduce our data.
cues.zh: 清理、轉換資料之後，下一步是縮減資料。

cues.en: Why reduce our data?
cues.zh: 為什麼要縮減？

cues.en: Don't we want as much data as possible?
cues.zh: 不是想要盡可能多的資料嗎？

cues.en: Well, theoretically, yes.
cues.zh: 理論上，沒錯。

cues.en: But remember, everything costs money.
cues.zh: 不過記得，一切都有成本。

cues.en: The more data we have, the more CPU, the more energy it takes for us to run our computation.
cues.zh: 資料越多，執行計算所需的 CPU 與能源就越多。

cues.en: So if we're able to get the same result on less data, that actually saves us money.
cues.zh: 如果能用較少資料得到相同結果，實際上就能省錢。

cues.en: It saves companies money, especially big companies like Google that have a lot of data and run a lot of CPU.
cues.zh: 替公司省錢，尤其像 Google 這種擁有大量資料、使用很多 CPU 的大型公司。

cues.en: Sometimes the idea of data reduction can also be called dimensionality reduction.
cues.zh: 資料縮減有時也稱為降維，

cues.en: Or column reduction.
cues.zh: 或減少欄位。

cues.en: You can have many columns on your table, but it makes things really, really slow.
cues.zh: 資料表可以有很多欄，但會讓運算非常慢。

cues.en: So you can actually remove some columns that maybe you find irrelevant and won't be needed for your machine learning model.
cues.zh: 所以，可以移除一些你認為無關、不需要用於機器學習模型的欄位。

cues.en: Again, these are things that Daniel is going to go through, but I want you to keep this in mind, this idea that as a data scientist, you can't just assume all data you have is automatically going
cues.zh: 同樣，Daniel 會介紹這些事。不過，想請你記住，身為資料科學家，不能直接假設手上的所有資料，自動

cues.en: to be perfect.
cues.zh: 就是完美的。

cues.en: You have to clean it.
cues.zh: 必須清理。

cues.en: You have to transform it.
cues.zh: 必須轉換。

cues.en: You have to reduce it.
cues.zh: 必須縮減。

cues.en: This idea of wrangling data, of moving around data into a form that is useful to you is part of the skill.
cues.zh: 這種整理資料，把資料調整成對自己有用的形式，也是技能的一部分。

cues.en: So watch Daniel do that and learn along the way.
cues.zh: 所以，看 Daniel 示範，一路學習。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下一支影片見。

cues.en: Buh bye.
cues.zh: 再見。
